text: pajahatha taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati . rūpā na tumhākaṃ . cakkhuviññāṇaṃ ... cakkhusamphasso .pe. yampidaṃ manosamphassapaccayā uppajjati vedayitaṃ sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā tampi na tumhākaṃ taṃ pajahatha taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissatīti . aṭṭhamaṃ . [150] yampi bhikkhave na tumhākaṃ taṃ pajahatha taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya bhavissati . kiñca bhikkhave na tumhākaṃ . cakkhuṃ bhikkhave na tumhākaṃ taṃ pajahatha taṃ vo pahīnaṃ hitāya sukhāya
